title: Speaking Practice: Cue Card and Discussion

sections.instructions: Part 2. You have one minute to prepare and up to two minutes to speak.

speaking_prompts.prompt: Describe a place you visited that was very different from where you live.
bullets: and explain how you felt about the visit

sections.instructions: Part 3. Discussion questions linked to the cue card.

speaking_prompts.prompt: Why do people enjoy visiting places that are different from home?

follow_ups.text: Do older and younger people look for different things when they travel?
Is it possible to enjoy a different culture without travelling?

speaking_prompts.prompt: Does travel always help people understand other cultures?

follow_ups.text: What else can help people understand another culture?

speaking_prompts.prompt: How has tourism changed the places people visit?

follow_ups.text: Who benefits most from tourism in a town or city?
Should governments limit the number of tourists in popular places?
